suggestions.topic: Hoodi fork go/no-go decision for Dec 14-17
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #249 penciled in Hoodi fork for week of Dec 14 contingent on ACDC go/no-go decision locking in current Glamsterdam spec. This is the last ACDE before that ACDC decision point and teams need clarity on rollout timeline.

suggestions.topic: Hegota scope decision based on client position papers
suggestions.rationale: Client teams were asked to submit one-paragraph scope positions (options 2-5) by end of week Nov 23-26. ACDE #250 should synthesize these inputs and move toward a scope decision, as devnet work is currently paused pending this clarity.

PFI raised in ACDE #247 with decision deferred to next call. Two meetings have passed without resolution. EIP-7954 raised contract limit without metering, creating DoS surface that EIP-7907 aims to address.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam spec change final decision and mainnet timeline
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #249 found no spec change had majority support, with most clients favoring current spec. Spencer's impact analysis doc and any concrete spec change proposals from Erigon/Besu were due before next ACDC. This call should confirm whether the current spec is locked for mainnet mid-Jan/late-Jan-early-Feb target.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8151 (Account Code Restricted ecRecover) risk assessment
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #249 flagged EIP-8151 as high-risk after preliminary scans showed many contracts depend on it. Currently CFI and in bogota-devnet-2 scope, but may not make Hegota. Teams need to decide whether to keep it in scope or defer.

suggestions.topic: Frames transaction spec finalization before holiday break
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #249 targeted spec-complete (all major changes merged) before mid-December holiday break. Two open spec changes remain: EIP-8288 signature list forward-compat and tree-root hashing scheme. Status update needed to confirm whether target is on track.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8077 (eth/xx mempool networking) expanded proposal review
suggestions.rationale: CFI'd in ACDE #247 conditionally pending expansion to include fee/frame fields beyond sender+nonce. Champion (Csaba) was to expand proposal but no update provided in subsequent meetings. Needs status check to confirm whether expansion is complete or if CFI should be reconsidered.

ACDE #249 mentioned ethrex (Iván) proposing minimal leanSPHINCS-on-frames EIP (ethereum/EIPs#12672), targeting PFI at next ACDE. This is a new proposal for initial discussion as part of the broader PQ cryptography strategy.
